CREATE TABLE t1(a, b, c, d);
  CREATE INDEX i1 ON t1(a, b, c);

EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN 
  SELECT * FROM t1 ORDER BY a, b, c

EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN 
  SELECT * FROM t1 ORDER BY a, b, +c

EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN 
  SELECT * FROM t1 ORDER BY a, +b, +c

EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN 
    SELECT * FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.b = t2.x
    WHERE t1.a = 5 AND t2.y = 0

EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN 
  SELECT * FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.b = t2.x
  WHERE t1.a = 5 AND t2.y = 0
